title: CIP · System overview
description: RED metrics (rate, errors, duration) and runtime health per service of the selected stack

panels.title: Services up
panels.description: Scrape targets of the stack that answered /metrics

targets.expr: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{profile="$profile", route!~"/metrics|/health.*"}[1m])) or sum by (service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_count{profile="$profile"}[1m]))

(sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{profile="$profile", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{profile="$profile"}[5m]))) or (sum by (service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_count{profile="$profile", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_count{profile="$profile"}[5m])))

(sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{profile="$profile", status=~"4.."}[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{profile="$profile"}[5m]))) or (sum by (service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_count{profile="$profile", status=~"4.."}[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_count{profile="$profile"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, service) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{profile="$profile", route!~"/metrics|/health.*"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_bucket{profile="$profile"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{profile="$profile", route!~"/metrics|/health.*"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_bucket{profile="$profile"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{profile="$profile", route!~"/metrics|/health.*"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service) (rate(collector_request_duration_seconds_bucket{profile="$profile"}[5m])))
topk(10, sum by (method, route) (rate(http_requests_total{profile="$profile", service="api", route!~"/metrics|/health.*"}[5m])))
topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{profile="$profile", service="api", route!~"/metrics|/health.*"}[5m]))))
